description: This file defines a Spring configuration class 'OpenApiDynamicConfig' that creates beans for configuring OpenAPI documentation. It provides a static OpenAPI object with API info and a customizer that dynamically sets server URLs based on the current HTTP request, resolving the base URL using a 'ServerResolver'.

classes.name: OpenApiDynamicConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines beans for OpenAPI setup with dynamic server URL resolution.

methods.name: OpenApiDynamicConfig
methods.description: Constructor that injects a ServerResolver instance.

methods.name: myBankOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAPI object with basic info about the API.

methods.name: dynamicServersCustomizer
methods.description: Provides an OpenApiCustomizer that sets the server URL dynamically based on the current HTTP request.

methods.name: currentRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current HttpServletRequest object from RequestContextHolder, with fallback for reflection if needed.
